limitations: No controlled same-scene before/after pair, no video/scene annotations.
Histograms merge guest flip intervals; no continuous presentation timeline.

NeoSwap operations are grouped by process/session. No build is inferred without matching native evidence; event loss/pending counters are retained. Absence of an operation cannot characterize unretained time.
Summed multi-thread and nested costs are not wall time.

app.scope: Historical unaligned text; message counts are not counts for the current native process.
